programmes.d: Kyle Green meets up with some friends at the Idaho Fish & Game to travel by snowmobile to remote lakes in the mountains of Idaho to ice fish for cutthroat trout.
In the season finale, Kyle Green and Jeff Hutchinson head to Maine to hunt for moose and learn about the conservation of this species which is under attack by winter ticks.
Kyle Green and his childhood friends are in his home state of Michigan for a trout fishing adventure; they visit dynamic landmarks, cliff jump, and finish out the trip cooking trout riverside.
Kyle and Jeff explore the oceans off the coast of Hawaii; they encounter sharks, manta rays and even jump off a 40-foot cliff.

The Atlanta Braves' Austin Riley will spend September and October holding it down on the hot corner in the MLB playoffs; since he can't hunt much during the early part of deer season, he usually hunts hard during December and January.
Realtree's Ben McDonald gets lucky again on his first sit in Nebraska; this time he rattles in an absolute big whitetail into Bow Range.
Tyler Jordan hunts with Perry Ross of Ross Trophy Outfitters.
WWE's Mark Calaway, aka "Undertaker," joins Realtree's David Blanton for a sandhill crane hunt in Texas. The crew put the Franchi Shotguns to work and harvested the "Ribeye of the Sky."
Join Tyler Jordan, Brandon Sheppard and Brantley Richardson as they hit the woods in Georgia during the peak of the November rut! Then, Tyler heads to Kansas in search of big Midwestern bucks.
Highlighting the stories and people who have made the shooting sports and hunting lifestyle a part of their lives.
The team at Winchester Ammunition has arrived in Oregon to visit the Leupold Long Range Academy. There, they'll put Winchester's new Supreme Long Range ammunition to the test.
Winchester athletes Kim Rhode and Desiree Edmonds share what it takes to compete at the highest level of clay target shooting.
Winchester team members and employees meet up at the Keefer Brothers property in Missouri for a multi-day deer camp; along for the ride are outdoor editors Scott Ergas and Dave Hurteau.

Big horn sheep are one of North America's most spectacular animals, but future conservation requires large-scale, hands-on efforts. Joining a multi-agency translocation in Texas, Dan Cabela is in the thick of it.

In the sparsely populated country of Namibia, in Southern Africa, Dan Cabela visits conservationist Robin Hurt to see how private land ownership and hunting have restored the landscape to a thriving wildlife area.

Andy starts his road trip around the United Kingdom in the Cotswolds where he sets out to hunt and taste the venison that Michelin star chef Mark Robinson has to offer.

SoCal summer is calling, and the Local Knowledge crew is back on Ali's home turf in San Diego, California. With reports of hot bites and fish moving in, the crew faces a classic Southern California dilemma.
With Meredith McCord halfway around the world, Capt. Justin Leake gives show producer Chris Hermans his first shot at landing a tarpon after filming them for nine seasons.
Captains Tom Rowland and Rich Tudor fish Florida Bay out of Hawks Cay, catching an incredible variety of flats species -- tarpon, snook, redfish, trout, bonefish and more.
